===============================================================================

SAM Framework

Research Document Template

===============================================================================



Purpose

-------

Use this template to document structured research performed to answer

architectural, operational, or technical questions.



Research exists to reduce uncertainty.



Research does not define policy.



Research does not define architecture.



Research does not become Knowledge until its findings have been

validated.



See:



\- KNOWLEDGE\_TEMPLATE.md

\- INCIDENT\_TEMPLATE.md

\- ADR\_TEMPLATE.md

\- TRUST\_MODEL.md

\- DECISION\_MODEL.md



===============================================================================

<!--

Author Checklist

----------------

\-->



# Author Checklist



\- \[ ] Objective defined

\- \[ ] Scope documented

\- \[ ] Hypotheses recorded

\- \[ ] Methodology explained

\- \[ ] Evidence referenced

\- \[ ] Findings justified

\- \[ ] Limitations documented

\- \[ ] Recommendations provided

\- \[ ] Cross references validated



---



<!--

Common Mistakes

---------------

\-->



# Common Mistakes



\- Treating assumptions as findings.

\- Omitting methodology.

\- Ignoring contradictory evidence.

\- Reporting conclusions without supporting evidence.

\- Failing to document limitations.

\- Deleting negative results.



---



<!--

Completion Checklist

--------------------

\-->



# Completion Checklist



\- \[ ] Metadata complete

\- \[ ] Evidence reviewed

\- \[ ] Review completed

\- \[ ] Recommendations finalized

\- \[ ] Ready for repository publication



---



# Summary



Summarize:



\- the research question,

\- the methodology,

\- the evidence,

\- the findings,

\- the remaining uncertainty,

\- and the recommended next steps.
